source: GUARDRAILS.md + DECISIONS.md + PROCESS.md + PERSONAS.md + spec constraints
note: Every policy must cite the rule it enforces. Unknown check types fail the gate (fail-closed).

policies.source: GUARDRAILS.md — never commit .env*, secrets, keys, tokens
policies.description: No real environment file, private key or credential file may be tracked.

policies.source: GRAPH-SCHEMA.md — the ledger is the single source of truth
policies.description: The atom being verified must exist in the ledger.

policies.source: SPEC-FORMAT.md — every AC must have ≥1 executable evidence hook
policies.description: An evidence command must be supplied.

policies.source: QA mandate — evidence must reference files that exist
policies.description: Every tracked evidence path must exist on disk.
Every domain declared by the atom's spec must map to a persona.

policies.source: D10 — a workflow run may never cite its own success
policies.description: An evidence command must not cite the current HEAD commit (self-reference).

policies.source: GUARDRAILS.md — no force-push, no history rewrite
policies.description: A force-push may never be part of a gated action.

policies.source: D1 + architect mandate — no new runtime deps without an ADR
policies.description: A newly added runtime dependency must be named in DECISIONS.md.
No atom may remain open when completion or release is declared.

policies.source: PERSONAS.md advance rule — zero block, zero unresolved request_changes among required personas
policies.description: The tiered quorum for the phase must be complete and approving.

policies.source: QA mandate — stale evidence re-opens the affected atom
policies.description: No evidence node may be stale.

policies.source: V-002 — certification must not overstate what was produced
policies.description: The certification's claims must re-derive from the ledger and the artifacts.
The gate chain must be green.

policies.source: GUARDRAILS.md — release tags are v1.x.y, never v1.0.0-prod-style
policies.description: A release tag must match vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.

judgment.question: Does this release's declared scope exceed the evidence recorded for it? Answer with JSON only: {"verdict":"pass"|"fail","confidence":0..1,"reasons":["..."]}.
